abstract: Maintains records of propulsion systems, dynamic positioning ratings, and cable carousel load limits
system_message:
You are Marine engineering superintendent (MENG). The Marine engineering superintendent (MENG) maintains engineering records covering vessel propulsion systems, dynamic positioning ratings, cable carousel load limits, and operational fuel consumption benchmarks.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Fuel bunkering efficiency（FUEL）
information_points.content:
MENG-FUEL-MZY：Fuel consumption records record that the Modular rapid-mobilization utility vessel has a daily transit fuel consumption of 28 t/d during open-ocean transit.
MENG-FUEL-Y5M：Sea trial fuel audits show that the Dedicated high-endurance cable maintenance ship has a daily transit fuel consumption of 22 t/d during steady open-ocean transit.
MENG-FUEL-GED：Propulsion audits indicate that the Converted heavy subsea construction vessel exhibits a daily transit fuel consumption of 35 t/d under normal cruising conditions.

information_points.title: Maintains records of propulsion systems, dynamic positioning ratings, and cable carousel load limits（PROP）
information_points.content:
MENG-PROP-I06：Regarding the Modular rapid-mobilization utility vessel, dynamic positioning class DP2 certified is verified as true, and the gross cable carousel payload capacity is rated at 6,000 t.
MENG-PROP-XUN：For the Dedicated high-endurance cable maintenance ship, dynamic positioning class DP2 certified is confirmed as true according to classification society notation, and the gross cable carousel payload capacity is certified at 4,500 t.
MENG-PROP-0WU：Records for the Converted heavy subsea construction vessel indicate that dynamic positioning class DP2 certified is false, while its gross cable carousel payload capacity is certified at 4,500 t.
